I maethas maetha i lad lain Gemini 3.5 Flash.

help.title: MosaicView - Grest
help.intro: Na MosaicView ce maethach ar gwistach perf noth pen tolthad o i livn. I maethas maer ero vi pan 64 bits.
help.open_files_content:
• Apho vi « Edro parlas » egor logo a dodo parlas vi henneth
• Cant maer : CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF, im (JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, GIF, ICO). Ce edrach eithro perlais EPUB, eb ero i im tolthar (i pith lithannen). Sarth : i dâl tanannen na caran (WEBP, TIFF, GIF, ICO…) tanar cant ú-maer an maethas hennad iaur CBZ/CBR. Eb MosaicView maetha hin na rhaed senu.
• PDF na peth hûl (baurannen an edrad) : ú-tolthui i barlas, dŷl tanannen.
• PDF barn o gwist (peth hûl i aran) : i phelt tolthannen. MosaicView anna haudhad adu lediannen i barlas vi colch ain.
• PDF na edrain an i im, egor im ristannen mîn pelt edaid : vi henneth cilad meiras, cilo i im caetheb (pen edrain a phith). Toltha ero i im i PDF, na i meiras caetheb, a ianna i im ristannen mîn i phelt ir i rest glân. I pith ar i panu i phelt ú-tolthar. Ce cilach eithro hen ir tolthach PDF vi barf edrannen.
• Hirad pelt gwanon : ir edrad levn, i phelt ain (dŷl cethed egor iannad) tanannen na gaud na till culuin vi emig. I garf « Maetho i ngwenyn » (narth Gwist, Apho na forvo vi sarnem egor vi emig) edra henneth gar i ngwenyn, na taith an palt an haedad i adu laew.
• Tolthad o i nath : logo em (egor lîf na palt) o maethas-nath na sarnem, egor maetho « Toltho o i nath » (narth Parlas, egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem) an annad men. I im goiannen vi methed, vi pan i dodad.
help.mosaic_content:
I harnem tana pain i phelt i barf lín sui emig. Ce :
• Adpanno i phelt na logad a dodad (adnediad na gaud, na rhaed adnediad edrannen)
• Cilo pelt laew (Ctrl+Apho egor Shift+Apho)
• Gwisto daeras emig na lad egor Ctrl+rind
• Tíro emig an tanad golu : eneth, daeras parlas, daeras, noth till, DPI, nûras crui ar, an em cuin, noth i im
• Adesto i pherlais na gam na aphad vi eneth
• Logo a dodo perlais parf (CBZ/CBR/CB7/CBT/PDF) o Explorer Windows vi parf egel edrannen an iannad
• Menno pain emig tanannen vi colch cilen (carf dolen, ero na Ctrl+Alt+T)
• Tano sarnem bîn : sath na forvo i harnem, tana pain i phelt pîn, na cant-canad i sad tanannen hí. Apho egor logo an menad vi barf. Edrannen o narth Pan egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem.
help.mosaic_frames_content:
Rain caran ar rain culuin :
• Rain caran : i balt feithannen, ú-tanannen. Apho na forvo vi emig : Adpanno egor Haedo. Ce i barf ú-haudhannen ; MosaicView tana ir haudhad.
• Rain culuin : i balt tanannen, ach feithannen ce : noth i balt ú-vaer na parlas. Tíro i balt vi Tírad, a Adpanno egor Haedo ir ú-vaer. I rain toblannen ir gwistannen. Ir haudhad, MosaicView tana.
Tíro emig gar rain an tanad golu.
help.manipulation_content:
• Logo a dodo pelt an adpannad
• Logo a dodo parf bân vi parf egel an iannad
• Apho na forvo vi palt an tíriad i narth (pernad, haedad...)
• Apho edaid vi palt an edrad i Dírad
• Menno pelt na logad na colch Windows, egor na Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V
help.renumber_content:
MosaicView anna rhaed neledh adnediad i phelt, na carf adnediad, narth (Apho na forvo), taith vi lîr golu, egor na gaud ir logad a dodad :

• Rhaed hirad pelt laew (rhaed senu) : i maethas ceth i landas pain pelt an hirad pelt edaid, neledh... I phelt laew adnediannen (sui : palt edaid 003-004, palt neledh 005-006-007). Ab 4 pelt, ero noth minui ar medui tanannen (sui : 010---025).

• Rhaed nediad athgar : pain pelt cavar noth er (001, 002, 003...), pen landas i phelt.

• Rhaed OFF : adnediad na gaud hollen. I eneth caetheb hebnen, eithro ir logad a dodad.

An gwistad i rhaed, Apho na forvo vi carf adnediad egor Apho vi taith vi lîr golu, nu na forvo. Golu tana i rhaed edrannen. I rhaed cilen maer eithro an logad a dodad, ar rennen o lû na lû.
help.flatten_content: Ir i levn lín gar nugylch, maetho « Echado i chylch laden » an pannad pain im vi lad er.
help.viewer_content:
Apho edaid vi palt an edrad i Dírad :
• ← → : menad mîn i phelt
• D : gwistad mîn rhaed hennad canad
  - Palt ereb : palt er vi lû
  - Pelt edaid : palt 1 ereb, ar 2-3, 4-5...
  - Pelt edaid anann : palt 1 ereb, ar 2-3, 3-4, 4-5...
  - Webtoon : an im tair (webcomics), landas na 900 px an hennad ; i rind perna vi balt, ar gwista i balt ir am egor nu
• Rind : menad lim (vi balt, vi rhaed Webtoon)
• Ctrl+rind egor Ctrl++/- : ganno (na 1 000 % i daeras naed i em)
• Ctrl+0 : camma na daeras i henneth
• Ctrl+1 : daeras 100 % (daeras naed i pixels)
• Apho na forvo + logo : logo i em tanannen ir beleg o i henneth
• F11 : henneth bant
• Apho edaid : perno na henneth bant
• Échap : daro i deithad (rest, taerechad, cant…) egor gwaeo o i Dírad
• Taith : ir i teith cuin, i balt hí rennen na gaud ir holad (eb palt minui/medui). Rib caran tanannen vi emig vi sarnem. Ir edrad ad, narth anna adiestad vi balt hen. Haedad na gaud vi balt medui, egor na gam na Apho na forvo vi Tírad. I teith hollen na senu : Apho na harvo vi aerem rib, nu na forvo i lîr golu, edra egor hol hin (an pain saith, rennen o lû na lû) ; Apho na forvo vi aerem hen covra i daith i barf edrannen egor pain teith. Ir hollen, ú-pannar ar adiestad ú-annen, eb i teith sí tanannen vi sarnem. Narth Livn ar narth aphad na forvo vi sarnem annar eithro, an rhaed i hath, « Edro i teith » egor « Holo i teith ».

Lîr carf : tíro am i em an tanad hen (toblar ab luig). Apho vi aerem an edrad i garf :
• Rest : teitho cant, gwisto i glân, cavo ; Apho na forvo vi aerem an rhaed fân i rest (haudho cant na « Haudho i fân », ar reno hen vi pelt abor na « Reno i fân » — maer an rest ain vi pelt laew ; « Lítho i fân » covra i fân, palt na palt)
• Taerechad : teitho lîr vi i boe laidh/tair, i gwist caro na gaud ; Apho na forvo vi aerem an taerechad na gaud (hira i bend, pen teithad)
• Pernad/cenedril : aphad er perna egor cenedril i balt
• Echad adu : Ctrl+Apho an cilad i eithel, ar emmo na Apho hebnen an echad adu. Hebo Shift ir teithad an tanad ar carad lîr taer ab i leithian, egor Shift+Apho ab aphad minui an teithad lîr taer mîn i till tâd
• Carf hîth : hebo Apho na harvo ar logo vi sad an hîth (daeras ar tûr said) ; i hîth goianna ir logach dan. Hebo Shift ir teithad an tanad ar carad lîr taer hîth ab i leithian, egor Shift+Apho ab aphad minui an teithad lîr taer mîn i till tâd
• Pith : Apho an pannad sath pith, cilo tîw/daeras/crui
• Caint : emmo rind, cant-canad, lîr egor pilin, na mainc an gwistad daeras
• Lad (maegas, calad/egelas, cruith, haedad i chrui, gwelthad) : i ngwist tanannen hí ir logach i lad
• Lad : gwisto till vorn/gamma/till nim, egor toltho crui o i em na tolthyr
• Heledhras : Apho vi crui i em an echad heledhren
• Nûras crui, Gerth, Rhaed em : cilo na Apho, carnen hí
• Panno em : panna i em o colch-pannad (aerem edrannen ero ir colch-pannad gar em), na mainc an gwistad daeras/pernad sui caint ; maer eithro na logad palt o sarnem egor parlas o Explorer Windows na Dírad. Ctrl+C echad adu i balt tanannen (ero vi rhaed palt ereb egor Webtoon), Ctrl+V panna em, sui vi sarnem

Cavo na « Cavo » ir tanannen, egor Échap an darad. Pain gwist minnar i narth Dangaro/Adgaro.
help.join_pages_content:
Cilo pelt laew, Apho na forvo → « Ianno i phelt gilin » an iannad laidh egor tair. I gant i em sain ain na pelt eithel ir pain ain, egor PNG. Ce cilach haedad egor hebad i phelt caetheb. Pelt ICO anna em PNG. I garf sí eithro vi narth Im ar na aerem Ianno i phelt.

Im cuin (GIF, WEBP, PNG, AVIF) : iannar ir gar noth im ain ar lû ain (sui sath em cuin thagnen). I em sain cuin, na gant i eithel ir ain, egor GIF cuin. I sad heledhren panna vi nim. Em cuin ú-iannui na em ú-cuin : sen, egor ir i mínem egel, Ianno hollen.

Sad i balt sain vi sarnem :
• Rhaed adnediad edrannen (gaud egor athgar) : i balt minna sad i balt minui iannen (vi sad tîn ir i eithel haedannen, nui hen egor), ar adnediad iesta.
• Rhaed adnediad OFF : i balt goiannen vi minui i harnem na eneth « Iannad_xxx ».
help.split_pages_content:
An thagad pelt edaid na gaud :
• Cilo i phelt an thagad
• Apho na forvo → « Thago i balt gilen »
• Cilo i ven (tair egor laidh)
• I im cuin (GIF, WEBP, PNG, AVIF) heb i vínem vi pain saith

MosaicView sí vi lem laew.
Na senu, i maethas hira na gaud i lam i pan lín, ar tana hen ir maer. Ir i pan lín maetha lam ú-maer, i maethas tana English.
Ce gwistach i lam na gam ir anírach na i narth nu i dagol aerim, nu i lad daeras emig. I gilith lín rennen ar carnen ir i maethas edra ad.
LEM : Deutsch, English, al-Arabiyya, Hayeren, Balgarski, Zhongwen (jiǎntǐ), Zhongwen (fántǐ), Hangugeo, Hrvatski, Dansk, Español, Eesti, Suomi, Français, Ellinika, Hindi, Magyar, Bahasa Indonesia, Gaeilge, Íslenska, Italiano, Nihongo, Latviešu, Lietuvių, Bahasa Melayu, Malti, Nederlands, Norsk, Polski, Português, Română, Slovenčina, Slovenščina, Svenska, Tamil, Čeština, Thai, Türkçe, Ukrainska, Tiếng Việt.
LEM ÔL : Klingon (tîw latin a tîw pIqaD), Sindarin (tîw latin a tîw Tengwar), Quenya (tîw latin a tîw Tengwar).

I maethas hen maetha i dîw Windows, eb i dîw pIqaD (lam Klingon) ar Tengwar (lem edhellen : Sindarin ar Quenya). I dîw hin lain, ar o palt-nath hin :
- an pIqaD (tîw i lam Klingon) : {url_piqad}
- an Tengwar (tîw edhellen, an Sindarin ar Quenya) : {url_tengwar}
Ir i balt-nath hin ú-sí, ce tolthach i dîw pIqaD ar Tengwar na Apho vi carf nu :

I maethas hen echannen vi lam Français. I tharchol vi lem egel carnen na IA, na Claude. Annon lem 40, eb ú-pedin pain lem hin. Sen thond maethon i IA : ú-annon pant an tharcholor 40. Hen gaud, dŷl ce sí vi tharchol. Goheno nin.

Aerem er, i aerem i maethas Windows, echannen na nin (na IA, an emmor ogol beleg nin). Ce maethach aerem hen ir tanach i eithel.
help.split_ui_content:
MosaicView ce tana levn tâd vi lû er, na harvo a forvo.

Apho vi aerem Thago an edrad sath tadui. Pain saith said : ce edrach, gwistach ar haudhach levn vi hen. I sath edrannen tanannen na glân luin.

An logad pelt o sath na sath, logo hin. Ir pelt laew cilin, menar pain. I phelt minnar vi sad tanannen na lîr caran.

Apho vi aerem « Holo i sath tadui » an dammen na sath er.

I lîr mîn i sath tâd ce logui. Apho edaid vi hen panna i sath ain (50/50).
help.config_clipboard_note: Eb : i pherlais lû i colch-pannad Windows (perlais clipboard_XXXXX) hebnen an 12 oreth ab echad adu, an pannad ab holad i maethas. Ab 12 oreth, haedannen na gaud.
help.config_log_note: I gwistad hoth PDF, CBR ar im erib na CBZ echad narth ir dŷl. I pherlais hin (Log_pdftocbz_…, Log_cbrtocbz_… ar Log_imgtocbz_…, na aur ar oreth) hebnen ab holad i maethas, an tírad ab. Haedannen ero na « Covro i pherlais lû » am. Parlas Log_scan.txt haudha pain cethed (cethor, pan, carnen egor dŷl) — maer an tírad dŷl na cethor lín.
help.config_error_log_note: Ir dŷl na MosaicView (dŷl ú-abgennen, dŷl tanannen, dant i maethas PDF), i dŷl haudhannen na narth dŷl, barlas er vi colch {errors_dir}. Ir pain maer, lad haudhannen. I dŷl ab 15 aur haedannen, ar i narth ú-or 5 MB. Ir press, maer an hennad egor an mennad i narth na MosaicView : dŷl o 7 aur mennin.
help.create_icon_content:
MosaicView ce echad perlais aerem (.ico) o em vi sarnem.
• Apho na forvo vi em → « Echado aerem »
• Risto i sad vi Tírad (i aerem boe cant-canad ain)
• Gwisto i heledhras ir baurach
• Cavo : i barlas .ico goiannen na sarnem
• I pherlais .ico gar pain noth till senu (16×16 na 256×256)
• Ir parlas .ico vi sarnem, haudhad vi levn CBZ bodannen : i gant ICO ú-maer vi livn hin. Menno i barlas .ico said (Ctrl+C ar panno vi colch Windows), ar haedo hen o i sarnem nui haudhad.
help.batch_convert_content:
MosaicView anna 8 carf gwistad hoth, ero ir i harnem lost. An pain, i men ain : cilo colch, cavo, tíro i ngwist, tíro i narn thent medui. Taith ce haedad i pherlais caetheb pen menad na colch-haedad.
• CBR → CBZ : gwista pain perlais CBR (RAR) i golch ar nugylch. Ir CBR ZIP, 7z egor TAR naed, i barlas adestannen na tâl maer (.cbz, .cb7 egor .cbt) pen gwistad. I pherlais adestannen ar i dŷl teithannen vi narth.
• CB7 → CBZ : gwista pain perlais CB7 (7-Zip) i golch ar nugylch. Ir CB7 ZIP, RAR egor TAR naed, i barlas adestannen na tâl maer (.cbz, .cbr egor .cbt) pen gwistad. I pherlais adestannen ar i dŷl teithannen vi narth.
• CBT → CBZ : gwista pain perlais CBT (TAR) i golch ar nugylch. Ir CBT ZIP, RAR egor 7z naed, i barlas adestannen na tâl maer (.cbz, .cbr egor .cb7) pen gwistad. I pherlais adestannen ar i dŷl teithannen vi narth.
• PDF → CBZ : gwista pain perlais PDF i golch ar nugylch. I im tolthannen pen adgwelthad.
• IM ERIB → CBZ : echad CBZ said an pain perlais em vi colch ar nugylch. I im ú-maer, feithannen, na pelt laew (TIFF) egor cuin (GIF) lithannen ar teithannen vi narth.
• TOLTHAD GOLU : toltha na gaud i olu (enas, lîr, ceryn…) o ComicVine an pain perlais maer (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF) i golch ar nugylch. Grest edra an pain perlais.
• ECHAD PARTHAM : nedia pain perlais maer i golch ar nugylch vi partham MosaicView sain (*.mvdb). Tíro i narn Partham an golu laew.
• ADGWELTHAD CBZ NA MEIRAS SENU : ceth pain perlais CBZ, CBR, CB7 ar CBT i golch ar nugylch. I gant naed i barlas hirnen pen i dâl : parlas na eneth ú-maer (sui .cbr i ZIP naed) adestannen na tâl maer nui maethad. Ero i CBZ naed adgwelthannen, ar ero ir ú-vi meiras senu. I narn thent medui tana noth i pherlais cethnen, adgwelthannen, vi meiras senu, ar lithannen (ú-CBZ).
help.icon_toolbar_content: I lîr aerim anna i garf beleg i maethas lim. Ce adpannach i aerim na logad vi lîr. An cilad aerim an tanad egor toblad, Apho vi carf rind nu i lîr : henneth pan edra, vi ce logach i aerim mîn i lîr ar i aerim dolen. Maetho « + » ar « − » an gwistad daeras i aerim. I pan haudhannen na gaud.
help.nfo_editor_content:
Parlas NFO parlas pith (tâl .nfo) an haudhad golu i levn : narn thent, ceryn, serth…

An echad parlas NFO, maetho i aerem vi lîr carf, i narth Parlas, egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem. I garf sí ero ir i harnem ú-lost. Anno eneth ar narn : i barlas panna vi sarnem, pen tolthad egor haudhad.

An gwistad parlas NFO, Apho edaid vi hen vi sarnem. I henneth edra na i eneth ar i narn, ar ce gwistach hin. Vi pain, i garth haudhannen vi narth Dangaro.
help.metadata_content:
MosaicView ce toltha na gaud i olu i pherf lín (enas, lîr, noth, ceryn, narn thent...) o i dond-golu ComicVine, palt-nath echannen na covas.

Rhaed parf er : edro parf, ar maetho i garf vi lîr carf egor i narth Golu. Grest na paid tâd edra : cilo minui i lîr, ar i noth. I olu teithannen vi parlas ComicInfo.xml vi levn.

Rhaed hoth : dodo colch egor cylch vi sarnem ar cilo « Tolthad golu na hoth », egor maetho i garf vi lîr carf egor i narth Golu. I grest edra an pain perlais hirnen (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF). I pherlais ú-CBZ gwistannen na gaud na CBZ ab teithad i olu.

Ledil API : ledil API ComicVine lain baurannen. I maethas tana i ven an tolthad hen. Tolthannen vi comicvine.gamespot.com ab echad genediad. I ledil ú-haudhannen pen hûl : barn na Windows DPAPI ar hennui ero na genediad Windows lín.

Taeg API : i daeg hin o ComicVine ar ú-gwistui.
• 200 mabed an eithel ar an oreth. Ir i daeg hirnen, i gestad ú-garnen an i methed i oreth.
• 100 hirnen beleg an mabed : an lîr na nyth laew, i gestad thagnen vi mabed laew.
• 1 mabed an s davnen na i balt-nath. An garthad, MosaicView dartha 2 s mîn mabed : mabed lim ce caetha taeg.

Cant men ComicVine : men palt ComicVine ce gar cant tâd, o i în tîn. MosaicView ista pain.
• Cant sain : comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4000-XXXXX an noth, comicvine.gamespot.com/.../4050-XXXXX an lîr.
• Cant iaur : comicvine.com/.../37-XXXXX an noth (i noth ab - ain ; ero i sad ar i noth minui gwistannen).

I garf hen o i maethas lain {scraper}.
help.library_content:
I partham anna nediad ar hirad perf lín. Henna i golu vi pain perlais (enas, lîr, ceryn, edannor…) ar cova hin vi parlas partham er (*.mvdb).

An echad partham, maetho i narth Partham → Thond-golu sain, egor dodo colch egor cylch vi sarnem ar cilo « Echado partham o i chylch ». MosaicView ceth i chylch lín ar nedia na gaud pain perlais maer.

Ab edrad i bartham, ce cilach perf na lîr, teithor, în, edannor..., na baudh laew. Apho edaid edra i barlas vi MosaicView. I hirnen ce mennar sui Excel (*.xlsx).
help.zip_compression_content:
MosaicView ce cil i meiras gwelthad ZIP an pain haudhad CBZ, na taith vi lîr golu, narth Pan, egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem.

I meiras senu 0 (ú-gwelthad) : i im parf gwelthannen eithro na cant tîn (JPEG, PNG, WEBP...), ar gwelthad i levn ZIP ú-anna sad, eb guir i haudhad ar i hennad. Ce gwistach i meiras, eb ú-maer, ero ir baurach.

I daith vi lîr golu tana i gwelthad naed i barlas edrannen : « 0 » ir ú-gwelthannen, « 1 » ir gwelthannen (i gant ZIP ú-tana i meiras caetheb), egor « -- » ir ú-CBZ. Apho na harvo vi taith anna adhaudhad i barlas (egor gwistad na CBZ) na meiras senu, ir maer. Apho na forvo edra i henneth i meiras senu.
help.wilhelm_scream_content:
Dŷl pîn ar lung tolthar i nallan Wilhelm, nallan maethannen vi mínim laew o 1950. Ir ú-istach, i balt Wikipedia (vi lam egel) tana : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilhelm_scream
I lhôn vi MosaicView o palt hen, gwistannen na cant WAV an hennad.
help.config_single_instance_note: MosaicView ú-edra tâd. Ir edrach parlas (na Apho edaid vi Explorer) ir i maethas edrannen, ú-henneth tadui : i barlas edra vi henneth sí, ar i henneth tana minui. An hen, MosaicView anna i eneth tîn na Windows ir edra (tíro nu).
help.config_registry_note: An tanad vi narth « Edro na » i Explorer Windows, MosaicView teitha golu pîn vi narth Windows ir edra. Hen thent : tana na Windows i sad MosaicView ar i nos perlais i edra. Teithannen ero vi sath narth Windows lín, ú-vi sath i pan, ar ú-gwista lîf perlais : cilad MosaicView sui maethas senu an nos parlas cilith lín, na narth « Edro na » Windows. Ir haedach MosaicView, i golu hen ú-maetha.
help.config_dir_content:
MosaicView echad parlas .mosaicview_config.json. I barlas gar i ban i maethas (henneth, rhaed, lam, rhaed adnediad…), i narth perf ar thond-golu gwain, i teith lín, ar i ledil API ComicVine lín (na hûl). Sí vi colch {config_dir} ar hebnen o lû na lû : eb i pherlais lû, ú-haedannen na gaud na MosaicView egor Windows.
Ce haedach hen na gam vi colch {config_dir}, egor na Apho vi carf nu. Echannen ad na meiras senu ir i maethas edra ad.
help.scan_content:
• Apho vi « Cetho » (tagol aerim, narth Parlas, egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem) an edrad i henneth cethed. MosaicView maetha i cethor lín (na WIA, i pan cethed Windows) : cilo i cethor, i noth till (DPI), i rhaed crui (crui / lad mith / morn a nim), ar Apho vi « Cetho ». I cethor boe lîf, cuin, ar i garf tîn pannen vi Windows an tanad vi narth.
• I cethor medui, i noth till ar i rhaed crui cilen rennen ar annen ad na gaud vi cethed abor.
• Ero cethed palt bân vi JPG annen : i maethas gar pain i baurannen an gwistad im ab.
• I em cethnen goiannen na gaud na sarnem, ab i phelt sí. Ab hen, ce risto, taerechad egor gwistad i chrui, sui palt egel.
• I garf hen maetha i cethor pen i maethas o i cethor, ar pen henneth pan tîn.
• Cethor er ce maethui ero na golain er : cethed ero vi sath er. Ir henneth cethed edrannen egor cethed sí vi sath, « Cetho » hollen vi sath egel an i methed.
help.straighten_content:
Taerechad na gaud (pen teithad) sí vi tagol aerim (Apho na forvo vi aerem « Taerechad » an gwistad i rhaed), i narth Im, egor Apho na forvo vi sarnem : hira i bend ar echad taer i balt egor i phelt gilin ; i sad lost o pernad pannar na nim. Maer an pelt laew vi lû er. Henneth narn thent tana noth i phelt echannen taer, ar i phelt ú-pend thand hirnen.

Taerechad na gam (teithad lîr thond) vi Tírad : tíro i narn Tírad.
help.macro_content: I garf Haudhad (aerim « Haudho » / « Henno » vi lîr carf i Dírad) haudha paid carnen vi palt, ar adgara hin ain vi palt egel — o i Dírad egor, an pelt laew, o i sarnem (narth Im, Apho na forvo, tagol aerim). Henneth narn thent medui tana i phelt maethannen, maethannen na sath egor ú-garnen, na thond i dŷl.
